name: SciSafeEval
description: SciSafeEval is a comprehensive benchmark designed to evaluate the safety alignment of large language models across a wide range of scientific tasks and languages, including textual, molecular, protein, and genomic languages. It tests LLMs in zero-shot, few-shot, and chain-of-thought settings, and includes a jailbreak enhancement feature to rigorously challenge safety guardrails.
reputation: A recent arXiv benchmark that is still emerging in the literature and has not yet seen broad community adoption.
notes: Includes scientific languages beyond text and introduces a jailbreak feature to test safety guardrails; surpasses existing safety datasets in scale and scope.
